idle: Exact Al-Kasal identity, indigo stone, huge long arms and short legs, hood, rounded nose, tired violet eyes, cyan rimlight. Side profile facing left, heavy idle guard, transparent alpha, no VFX or floor.

variants.attack: Heavy forward horizontal arm swipe toward LEFT, long front arm extended, body leaning into blow. Feet planted.
variants.hit: Recoiling from a blow arriving from LEFT, torso and head leaning backward RIGHT, huge hands raised, pained annoyed expression.
variants.critical: Devastating overhead hammer-fist smash toward LEFT, one gigantic arm raised above shoulder and descending, forceful crouch. Distinct from horizontal swipe.
variants.dodge: Heavy low evasive lean backward RIGHT, knees crouched, arms tucked close, watching opponent LEFT. Deliberate evasion, not injured.
variants.combo: Follow-through wide low sweeping arm strike toward LEFT, torso rotated, rear heel lifted, long arm across belly. Distinct flowing chained strike.
variants.replay: Compact renewed attack toward LEFT, low forward step and tight rising uppercut with huge fist, opposite arm pulled back. Distinct from swipe and overhead smash.

constraints: One full-body sprite per call, same anatomy/scale/pelvis, feet about 91% height, actual transparent alpha, no text/UI/background/shadow/effects. Variants edit generated idle.
